2944052904a3f1d170c46769c9c1fa5d7be23118.summary: Free decryptor page from Emsisoft, published 2016-12-23, for GlobeImposter ransomware. GlobeImposter is a copycat of the Globe ransomware kit that imitates its ransom notes and file extension. Encrypted files get a .crypt extension and keep their base name. Decryption needs a matching pair of an encrypted file and its unencrypted original. The tools may not work on all ransomware versions and are provided without warranty.

29f0d3fb11935b6922316bd01163d21b625f9ab5.summary: Malpedia family page for Hades, a ransomware family. PCrisk describes Hades Locker as an updated version of WildFire Locker that encrypts many file types with AES. The page lists 17 dated reports from 2021 to 2025 by vendors and researchers including Sentinel LABS, Mandiant, CrowdStrike, Secureworks and Accenture. Named actors include Evil Corp, UNC2165 and GOLD WINTER. Tools named include Cobalt Strike, Meterpreter and MimiKatz. The page notes there is no YARA signature yet.
